question: If a + b + c = 8 and ab + bc + ac = 14, then what is the value of (a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc)?
solution:
Given:

a + b + c = 8

ab + bc + ac = 14

Formula used:

x3 + y3 + z3 - 3xyz = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)2 - 3(xy + yz + zx)]

Calculation:

Putting the values in the formula we get

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = 8 × (82 - 3 × 14)

⇒ 8 × (64 - 42)

⇒ 8 × 22

⇒ 176

**∴ The value of a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc is 176.**
